label: Boltraffio and Marco d'Oggiono

claims.statement: Milanese painters working in the manner of Leonardo. Their status as pupils or associates is debated.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Stylistic dependence; workshop traditions.

value.text: Two assistants named in the 1490 to 1491 Salai theft notes

claims.statement: Leonardo's notes on Salai's thefts (Paris MS C, dated 1490 to 1491) are reported to name a 'Marco' and a 'Gian Antonio' in the house as victims. Identifying them with Marco d'Oggiono and Giovanni Antonio Boltraffio is an interpretation.

sources.cite: Standard literature. Model recall, not checked in this session.

check_in: Institut de France, MS C f. 15v (to confirm)

open_questions: Group record of two painters; split bars recommended (pe-boltraffio-gian, pe-oggiono).

flags: The bar shows an overlap in time and place. It does not record a relationship.
